rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Frontend was using old service model field names (setup_cost, monthly_cost) but backend uses new 4-field pricing model (setup_cost_conventional, monthly_cost_conventional, setup_cost_outsourcing, monthly_cost_outsourcing). This would cause NaN to appear when calculating and displaying service prices in the quote wizard.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Updated all references in Quotes.jsx to use the correct field names with || 0 fallback for safety
